meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared README three-RAG processing diagram and runtime docs against both actual AiClient loops, RuntimeAgentToolRegistry, AgentInstructionService and scoped data/trace services.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the backend skill changes and capability boundary against unchanged account/login authorization: anonymous cart/status handles cannot read accounts, saved addresses or private owner records; browser credentials do not authorize remote tools.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed ordered state/PIN match, exact integer paise, minimum and unmatched results, no stored rules or GST/order/payment mutation, and regression fixtures.

content.review_note: Reviewed browser snapshot bounds, per-owner and page key, revision conflict, explicit save token cleanup and unchanged MySQL CAS and publication status.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed preview-only native PHP service, owner/CSRF route and source-generated maps; no schema or database write.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed fixed Google v5 endpoint, canonical HTTPS origin, CSRF owner-only routes, bounded report projection and unavailable/quota states against integration documentation and fixtures.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed architecture guidance; existing safe failure/HTTP status boundary unchanged by deployment-neutral developer metadata.

interface.review_note: Reviewed actual owner shipping view, safe form, dry-run label, and explicit no quote outcomes.

mail.review_note: Reviewed AdminController addition confined to owner shipping preview; existing mail lifecycle unchanged.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed new PageSpeed integration documentation; owner Google reports are not exposed via MCP and client grants are unchanged.

media.review_note: Reviewed upload eligibility, revision hash, bounded UTF-8 metadata, row lock, exact patch, no row creation, and view/search/isolated DB tests.

operator-help.review_note: Checked owner shipping screen and help guide: dry run, current settings link, matching and unavailable outcomes.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked ProjectMapService owner preview route and unchanged public MCP capability registry.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed preview-only ShippingService and route: no call from checkout, cart, quote, order or payment persistence.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed MediaService metadata/search patch; URL, binary and usage fields used by published feeds remain unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Preserved all current browser acceptance lanes and added shipping preview browser test; regenerated maps.
